scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix apps/web install && npm run setup:api
scripts.setup:api: cd apps/api && uv sync && ([ -f .env ] || cp .env.example .env) && uv run alembic upgrade head && uv run python -m seed.seed
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:seed: cd apps/api && uv run python -m seed.seed
scripts.lint: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
